title: CFC-RIDI Phase F Neutral Arm Schema v0.2 R1
description: One-arm, outcome-blind adapter input class for CFC-RIDI v0.2 Phase F. This schema carries source/query/passages and one recorded downstream endpoint, but carries no authority, correctness, RIDI result, counterpart-arm data, or retrieval-grade information.

case_id.description: Stable case identifier for bookkeeping only. It must not drive semantic mapping, authority, or closure behavior.

arm.description: Arm identifier for bookkeeping only. The adapter receives exactly one arm instance at a time.

text.description: Exact registered question/claim text. This is query context, not evidence authority.

registered_context_line_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact LF-terminated registered source/context JSONL line from the frozen source corpus.

prompt_sha256.description: Hash binding to the exact registered prompt. Prompt text itself is withheld from the adapter view.

item_id.description: Exact registered passage/document identifier. Identifier distinctness does not establish evidence independence.

text.description: Exact registered passage text. Presence in this schema does not establish semantic support, authority, provenance, independence, scope, freshness, or correctness.

retrieved_items.description: Ordered registered source passages. Retrieval grades are intentionally absent from the adapter view.

canonical_output.description: The only endpoint field eligible to enter CFC as the candidate claim/conclusion value. It is not evidence, authority, or correctness.

adapter_visibility: Exactly one arm instance may be provided to the F2 adapter per mapping operation.
The counterpart arm must not be supplied through another field, side channel, cached pair object, or precomputed comparison feature.
The adapter must not compute or receive RIDI PASS/FAIL, endpoint equality/difference, correctness, gold labels, expected asymmetry, publication-interest labels, or passage retrieval grades.
candidate_claim_rule: recorded_endpoint.canonical_output may enter CFC only as the candidate claim/conclusion value.
recorded_endpoint.raw_output is audit/provenance material and must not be promoted to authority.
Neither endpoint field may be used as evidence, semantic support, provenance authority, identity authority, independence authority, or correctness.
source_content_rule: query.text and retrieved_items[].text are exact source content only.

item_id, text hashes, source hashes, case_id, arm, dataset, task, and model identifiers do not establish authority, semantic support, provenance, independence, scope, freshness, identity, or applicability.
Distinct item IDs must not be interpreted as independence.
authority_boundary: This schema contains no positive authority record.
Any positive authority used in Phase F must come from the separately frozen F4 authority universe and satisfy its frozen applicability/binding rules.
Missing authority must remain missing; the adapter must not infer or synthesize it from neutral-schema fields.
semantic_context_rule: This schema does not supply authoritative entity/event/version identity, decision as-of semantics, evidence polarity, epistemic role, provenance lineage, failure-domain topology, support-set independence, or scope applicability.
If the accepted F1 public interface and later F4 authority universe cannot faithfully supply required state without invention, Phase F must stop under the signed failure semantics.
interface_change_rule: If F2 requires any controller-facing class or method outside the bilaterally accepted F1 interface manifest, F1 must be versioned, amended, and bilaterally re-accepted before use.
If F2 requires a neutral-schema field not present here, this schema must be versioned and bilaterally re-accepted before use.
ordering_rule: Neutral-schema acceptance does not approve any adapter implementation.
F2 adapter development may begin only after bilateral exact-hash acceptance of this neutral-schema artifact.
